title: Late Delivery Claims Rate Card: Lateness Bands for a Missed Guarantee
content:
Delivery Claims rate card for a Late Delivery Claim: the share of the guarantee refund basis that is refunded, by how many days the delivery guarantee was missed by.

**Rate.** The lateness share depends on the days the guarantee was missed by — the days from the order's promised delivery date to its delivered date: a delay of at most one counted day refunds 50% of the guarantee refund basis, a delay of exactly two counted days refunds 75%, and a delay of three or more counted days refunds the whole basis.

| Days the guarantee was missed by | Share of the guarantee refund basis refunded |
|---|---|
| at most 1 (1, or fewer) | 50% |
| exactly 2 | 75% |
| 3 or more | 100% — the whole basis |

## Band edges

- 1 counted day: 50%. 2 counted days: 75%. The step from the first band to the second falls between 1 and 2.
- 2 counted days: 75%. 3 counted days: the whole basis. The step to the whole basis falls between 2 and 3.
- A count of 0 is at most one counted day and refunds 50%.
- There is no band above the whole basis: 3, 6 or 10 counted days all refund 100%.

## Worked figures (hypothetical guarantee refund basis of 20.00 USD)

| Counted days | Share | Refunded on this share |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 50% | 10.00 USD |
| 2 | 75% | 15.00 USD |
| 4 | 100% | 20.00 USD |
